items.requirement: Clean checkout migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and starts API, workers, dispatcher, and production UI with published commands.
OpenAPI, strict validation, stable errors, pagination, snapshot, and real browser flows match the public contract.
The bounded declarative expression language has exact typing, depth, size, path, and canonical JSON semantics without executable input.
Priority, terminal short-circuit, decision, tags, visited order, and SKIPPED explanation semantics are deterministic.
Publication rejects every published static conflict with deterministic sorted reports and no partial version change.
Unknown response, restart, and concurrent replay preserve one Evaluation identity and canonical body.
Replay uses original version and facts, preserves original evaluation, and produces a matching decision and explanation digest.
Evaluation, replay, and comparison leases recover from controlled process death without stale commits or duplicate facts.
Transactional Events are contiguous and remain byte-stable across unknown ACK without leaking facts.
ComparisonRun freezes corpus and versions, emits exact results, fences cancellation, migrates V1, and promotes through one CAS.
All three published sustained scenarios meet throughput, latency, recovery, resource, and post-load invariant requirements.
Project tests use real PostgreSQL, production Chromium, multiple processes, controlled SIGKILL, and actual load measurements.
Tenants, facts, credentials, Events, logs, snapshots, and private paths remain isolated and redacted.
Codex clearly explains rule semantics, ownership, failure boundaries, and review findings.
Handoff accurately reports commands, results, risks, and checks not run.
